September 4, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:07+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-4-1971-54677

Bangladesh government resumes pension for the eminent rebel poet Kazi Nazrul Islam after Pakistani administration halts it. In the poet’s Kolkata residence, High Commissioner of independent Bangladesh in India M Hossain Ali gives a cheque of Rs 2,100 to the poet.

From the Rawalpindi President’s Palace, a decree is issued: President Yahya announces general mercy to all who made any ‘mistakes’ in East Pakistan during the period between March 1 and September 5. It is applicable for all, including armed force members, EPR, police, Mujahid and Ansar.
